title: 11.5E: Matrices and Matrix Operations (Exercises)
originalText:
For the following exercises, perform the requested operations on the given matrices.

\[

A=\left[\begin{array}{rr}

4 & -2 \\

1 & 3

\end{array}\right], B=\left[\begin{array}{rrr}

6 & 7 & -3 \\

11 & -2 & 4

\end{array}\right], C=\left[\begin{array}{cc}

6 & 7 \\

11 & -2 \\

14 & 0

\end{array}\right], D=\left[\begin{array}{rrr}

1 & -4 & 9 \\

10 & 5 & -7 \\

2 & 8 & 5

\end{array}\right], E=\left[\begin{array}{rrr}

7 & -14 & 3 \\

2 & -1 & 3 \\

0 & 1 & 9

\end{array}\right]

\]

39. \(-4 A\)

40. \(10 D-6 E\)

\(41 . B+C\)

42. \(A B\)

43. \(B A\)

44. \(B C\)

45. \(C B\)

46. \(D E\)

47. \(E D\)

48. \(E C\)

49. \(C E\)

50. \(A^{3}\)
